name: The Myujishan Saga: The Forgotten Band
source:
A new seven part saga from Myujishan LLC!

Years ago, there was a humble music group, after walking to the bus from a concert, the lead singer had an incident that caused him to forget EVERYTHING!

[From [url=https://myujishan-llc.itch.io/myujisagapartone] itch.io[/url]]

Myujishan LLC推出的全新七部传奇故事！

多年前，有一个不起眼的音乐团体，从演唱会走到公交车上时，主唱发生了一件事情，让他忘记了一切！

[来自[url=https://myujishan-llc.itch.io/myujisagapartone] itch.io[/url]]
